text: This report is submitted to provide an update on the implementation of the City's Time, Attendance and Scheduling System within Parks, Forestry and Recreation and Toronto Paramedic Services, advise on the outcome of a risk assessment undertaken, and advise on the actions taken to address the issues and operational impacts identified during the September 25, 2017, Government Management Committee meeting.

The Government Management Committee received the report (December 22, 2017) from the Deputy City Manager, Internal Corporate Services, the Deputy City Manager, Cluster A and the Acting Chief Financial Officer for information.
